question_text: Explain how analysing historical supermarket transactions can inform future stocking decisions.
adaptation_rationale: Rebuilt scenario and response wording while retaining the supported reasoning; source-specific obsolete material excluded.
solution: Classification or regression can estimate demand from historical patterns; association rules can reveal products often bought together. Managers can combine those findings with current conditions to plan stock, while recognizing patterns are not guarantees about future demand.
